title: 第1377章 帝宫公主第1376章 不惜代价
content_zh:
赤骸冷哼一声，尽管有些不满，但还是点头道：
“放心，事成之后，神魔躯体便是你的。”
“甚好，甚好啊。”无面天王笑吟吟，而后转身缓缓走到帝川面前，轻声道：
“帝川，好久不见了，不如你我坐下来喝杯茶，叙叙旧，如何？”
“这打打杀杀的，不太好，你说呢？”
然而，帝川却是意味深长的点点头，十分认可的说道：
“嗯！不错不错，你说的非常有道理啊。”
随后，挥手间，一张亭子，几双椅子，一盏茶座出现在虚空中。
帝川率先坐下，自顾自的沏茶忙活起来。
这一操作，倒是让无面和赤骸两个都是有些看不懂了，一时间竟是有些愣住。
这个帝川，到底是在搞什么鬼？哪怕是帝宫太华等圣王强者都是有些懵。
如今这都是什么情况了，那赤骸明显是联手暗影会对我们人族动手了，竟是还有心思在和对方喝茶？
“嗯，无面兄，坐啊，站着做甚？”
“莫非还要我亲自动手请？”帝川信步闲庭的笑着说道。
赤骸扫了一眼，对着无面点点头。
帝川，既然你都不在乎这些圣王境了，也好，本殿便帮你亲自料理了便是。
眼看着赤骸就要动手，太华一时间忍不住的上前恭敬的神魂传音道：
“帝尊！您如今怎么还有闲心在这和暗影会这些垃圾喝茶？”
“那赤骸摆明是要对我们这些圣王出手，阴骨玉靠着我们几个圣王，可守不住啊。”
陵霄点头附和道：

“没错，帝尊，您到底在想些什么？”
帝川看着两位帝宫殿主，微微摇头叹气道：
“你们两个，这么毛躁做甚？”
“你不如看看齐长风，人家都淡定的在疗伤，你们两个着急什么？”
“你们两个还真的以为帝宫会任由着暗影会这群垃圾肆意妄为？”
要着急也是人家道宫急，毕竟，阴骨玉那可是道宫的媳妇。
随后帝川深深的看了一眼齐长风，微眯着双眸，心中呢喃道：“看来这家伙如此淡定，想必是在计划之中，道宫的这些弟子，还真的是有趣。”
当然，眼光最毒辣的，还是当属道祖这个老家伙。
怪不得长公主殿下对道祖会这般倾心，这可是有道理的啊。
闻言，太华两人有些疑惑的道：
“帝尊，如今帝宫不是只有您在坐镇么？”
“其余的两位帝尊不是都跟随帝君在那个鬼地方么？”
帝川狡黠一笑：“亏你们两个还是帝宫殿主，这偌大的帝宫若是光靠着我一人坐镇，邪魔一族和暗影会早就攻打下来了。”
太华两人听后眉头紧皱，随后心头猛然一震，似乎是想到了什么。
“嘶！”
“帝尊，您是说。。。此次，长公主殿下会亲自出手？！”
“可是，传闻长公主殿下不是在闭关修身养性么？更是对外说破破帝境不出关么？”陵霄殿主疑惑的说道。
帝川耸耸肩，神秘一笑道：
“嘘，长公主殿下的心思，你我等可不敢轻易揣摩。”
“是是是！”两人一想到当初长公主教训一众下属的情景，那叫做一个可怕。

同一时间。
content_en:
Chi Gu snorted coldly. Although he was a little dissatisfied, he still nodded and said:
"Don't worry, after the matter is completed, the body of the god and demon will be yours."
"Very good, very good." The Faceless King smiled, then turned around and walked slowly to Dichuan, saying softly:
"Di Chuan, long time no see, how about you and I sit down and have a cup of tea and catch up on old times?"
"It's not good to fight and kill, what do you think?"
However, Dichuan nodded meaningfully and said with great approval:
"Yeah! Not bad, what you said makes perfect sense."
Then, with a wave of his hand, a pavilion, several pairs of chairs, and a tea seat appeared in the void.
Dichuan took the lead and sat down, minding his own business making tea.
This operation made Wu Mian and Chi Skeleton a little confused, and they were stunned for a moment.
What the hell is this Dichuan doing? Even the powerful Saint Kings such as Imperial Palace Taihua were a little confused.
What is going on now? Chi Gu has obviously teamed up with the Shadow Club to take action against our human race, but is he still thinking about drinking tea with him?
"Well, Brother Faceless, sit down. What are you doing standing up?"
"Do you want me to personally invite you?" Dichuan said with a leisurely smile.
Chi Gu glanced at it and nodded to Wu Mian.
Dichuan, since you don’t care about these Saint King realms, it’s okay, this palace will help you take care of it yourself.
Seeing that Chi Gu was about to take action, Taihua couldn't help but stepped forward and said respectfully:
"Emperor! Why do you still have the time to drink tea with trash like the Shadow Society?"
"That Chi Gu is clearly planning to take action against us Holy Kings. The Yin Bone Jade cannot be defended against us Holy Kings."
Lingxiao nodded and agreed:
"That's right, Emperor Zun, what are you thinking about?"
Di Chuan looked at the two imperial palace masters, shook his head slightly and sighed:
"Why are you two so impatient?"
"Why don't you take a look at Qi Changfeng? He is calmly recovering from his injuries. Why are you two so anxious?"
"Do you two really think that the Imperial Palace will allow the Shadow Society to do whatever they want?"
If you want to be anxious, it is because the Taoist palace is anxious. After all, Yin Guyu is the daughter-in-law of the Taoist palace.
Then Di Chuan took a deep look at Qi Changfeng, narrowed his eyes slightly, and murmured in his heart: "It seems that this guy is so calm, he must be in the plan. These disciples of the Dao Palace are really interesting."
Of course, the one with the most vicious eyes is the old guy Daozu.
No wonder Her Royal Highness the Princess is so enamored of Dao Zu, it makes sense.
Hearing this, Taihua and the others said with some confusion:
"Emperor, aren't you the only one in charge of the Imperial Palace now?"
"Aren't the other two emperors following the emperor in that ghost place?"
Dichuan smiled slyly: "Fortunately, you two are still the masters of the Imperial Palace. If this huge Imperial Palace was controlled by me alone, the Demon Clan and the Shadows would have attacked it long ago."
Taihua and the two frowned after hearing this, and then their hearts suddenly shook, as if they thought of something.
"Hiss!"
"Emperor, are you saying...that Her Royal Highness the Princess will personally take action this time?!"
"But, isn't it rumored that Her Royal Highness the Princess is in seclusion to cultivate her character? She is also saying that she will not leave seclusion after breaking through the imperial realm?" the master of Lingxiao Palace said doubtfully.
Dichuan shrugged and said with a mysterious smile:
"Hush, you and I don't dare to speculate on Her Royal Highness the Princess's thoughts."
"Yes, yes, yes!" When the two of them thought of the scene when the eldest princess taught all her subordinates, it was terrifying.
